priorityList: Use Disrupt to interrupt enemy casting.
Maintain Demon Spikes as your primary active mitigation while in combat.
Use Metamorphosis when your major cooldowns (Soul Carver, Sigil of Spite) are available or during execute phases.
Cast Fel Devastation on cooldown to trigger Metamorphosis and your Fel-Scarred Voidfall buffs.
While the Voidfall buff is active, use Spirit Bomb at 4+ Soul Fragments or Soul Cleave as a filler to spend stacks.
Apply Fiery Brand to targets to maintain the Fiery Demise damage buff.
Cast Immolation Aura on cooldown, especially to extend Fiery Brand duration if Charred Flesh is talented.
Use Sigil of Spite if you have 2 or fewer Soul Fragments.
Use Soul Carver if you have 3 or fewer Soul Fragments.
Cast Spirit Bomb as your primary Soul Fragment spender when you have 4 or more fragments.
Use Fracture to generate Soul Fragments whenever you are below 6 and need to reach your Spirit Bomb threshold.
Cast Sigil of Flame on cooldown for consistent AoE damage.
Use Felblade to generate Fury or if you need to close the gap to your target.
Cast Soul Cleave as a secondary spender if you have excess Fury but lack fragments for Spirit Bomb.
Use Throw Glaive as a filler if no other abilities are available and you are out of range.
